title: Bike Service Timeline
user: Owners of multiple bicycles who need a complete, portable component-service history and a clear next-service view across every bike.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA with bikes, components, service entries, receipts/photos, mileage/date triggers, and one chronological all-bike view exportable as CSV/print.
constraints: Local-first with explicit export/backup; retain only user-entered records; interval guidance is configurable and never safety certification.
